column1: # Imports ntcompat replaces, so binaries load on Windows NT 3.51 and NT 4.0.
# Each line: DLL, function, bytes of stdcall arguments, the first Windows
# version known to export it, and a note. The stub ntcompat_<function> in
# thunks.c calls the real function when the system has it, and otherwise
# a fallback. Under NTCOMPAT_EMULATE, functions newer than the emulated
# version take the fallback, so CI exercises them on new Windows.
kernel32    InitializeCriticalSectionAndSpinCount   8     4.0    NT 4.0 SP3; fallback InitializeCriticalSection
kernel32    IsProcessorFeaturePresent               4     4.0    SIMD answers always come from the ntcompat SIMD policy
kernel32    AreFileApisANSI                         0     4.0    NT 3.51 availability unconfirmed; fallback TRUE
ole32       CoTaskMemAlloc                          4     3.51   loaded on demand, so ole32.dll is not a static import; fallback process heap
